versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Intellectia Stock Forecast skill:

- Provides US stock, ETF, and crypto yearly forecasts and “Should I Buy?” Q&A via the Intellectia API.
- Supports two endpoints: price/entry/exit predictions (2026–2035) and structured investment rationale analysis.
- Fast setup instructions for OpenClaw users, including installation and troubleshooting tips.
- Example usage for both forecast and decision analysis included (curl/python).
- Strong disclaimers: informational use only; not investment advice.
- One-symbol queries per request; supports forced invocation and skill auto-matching phrases.
